# (hand): CrrPos is a mock, so a generated landing flag (mAcch.m_flags +0x3FC bit 0x80) stays set on
# every step of the N-step run, i.e. the item "lands" N times in one frame (a second bounce from the reflected speed)
# where the game's GroundCheck sets GROUND_LANDING only on the step that lands. N-step spec therefore runs without the landing
# bit; the landing branch is per event (one landing, on its step: speed reflected / speedF 0, mBounceCount + 1) and
# keeps its original form, dt-1 check covers it at dt = 1.
field 02489FA4 r3+0x3FC u32 0,0xFFFFFF7F
field 0248A1F4 r3+0x3FC u32 0,0xFFFFFF7F
field 0248A27C r3+0x3FC u32 0,0xFFFFFF7F
